description: Trigger evals for devrites-frontend-craft: model-invoked specialist that implements frontend at senior designer-engineer quality (every state, anti-AI-slop, WCAG 2.2 AA), routed from /rite-build when UI is detected.

queries.text: Build the UI for the new settings page.
queries.rationale: "build the UI" is the canonical trigger phrase in the description.

queries.text: I need this frontend to be ship-quality before we hand it over.
queries.rationale: "ship-quality frontend" named verbatim in the description.

queries.text: Stand up a design system for the app's components and tokens.
queries.rationale: "design system" is a named trigger.

queries.text: Make the booking form accessible — keyboard, visible focus, WCAG 2.2 AA.
queries.rationale: a11y + WCAG 2.2 AA is the skill's quality bar.

queries.text: Implement the dashboard so every state is covered — loading, empty, error, success.
queries.rationale: "every state covered" is the skill's core promise.

queries.text: I want this component built the way a senior designer-engineer would.
queries.rationale: Paraphrase of the skill's senior designer-engineer quality bar.

queries.text: Build this screen but make sure it doesn't look like generic AI output.
queries.rationale: anti-AI-slop is an explicit concern of this skill.

queries.text: Code up the new onboarding flow following the design-brief.
queries.rationale: Building UI to the design-brief is this skill's build target.

queries.text: Implement the export feature's frontend, reusing our existing tokens and components.
queries.rationale: Reuse-first frontend implementation is squarely this skill.

queries.text: Add the new modal — fully keyboard navigable with all the states handled.
queries.rationale: Oblique but clear: a11y + state coverage on a new UI element.

queries.text: Ship the pricing page UI at production quality.
queries.rationale: Production/ship-quality UI implementation matches the description.

queries.text: rite-build flagged this slice as UI — build the interactive data table.
queries.rationale: Description names "/rite-build detects UI" as a route into this specialist.

queries.text: Polish the dashboard UI before review.
queries.rationale: /rite-polish owns polishing an already-built feature.

queries.text: Run the full tests and browser-proof the finished UI end-to-end.
queries.rationale: /rite-prove owns proving the completed feature.

queries.text: Try a few radically different UI directions so I can pick one.
queries.rationale: /rite-prototype owns throwaway design exploration.
queries.owner_rationale: /rite-prototype owns throwaway design exploration. The functional owner is explicit-only, so natural language has no implicit owner.

queries.text: The dropdown is throwing in the console — debug why it crashes.
queries.rationale: diagnose owns systematic bug debugging.

queries.text: Grill me on my component API plan before I build it.
queries.rationale: grill-me owns interview/stress-test of a plan.
queries.owner_rationale: grill-me owns interview/stress-test of a plan.

queries.text: Do a code review of my frontend diff.
queries.rationale: code-review (and /rite-review) owns reviewing a diff.

queries.text: Let's red-green-refactor the date formatter util.
queries.rationale: tdd owns the test-first red-green-refactor loop.
queries.owner_rationale: tdd owns the test-first red-green-refactor loop.

queries.text: Compact this session into a handoff doc for the next agent.
queries.rationale: handoff owns conversation compaction for handover.
queries.owner_rationale: handoff owns conversation compaction for handover.
